questions.prompt: One zero of \(x^{3} - x^{2} - 4 x + 4\) is \(2\). Find the smallest of the three zeros. Answer: ______
questions.explanation: \(x-2\) is a factor (since \(p(2)=0\)). Dividing leaves a quadratic whose roots are \(-2\text{ and }1\). The smallest zero is \(-2\).

questions.prompt: Find the degree of the polynomial \(2 x^{3} - x^{2} y - 6 z^{2}\). Answer: ______
questions.explanation: Add the exponents of all the variables in each term; the degree of the polynomial is the largest of these sums: 2, 3, 3. So the degree is \(3\).

questions.prompt: The volume of a rectangular box is \(312\) cubic units. The length is 7 more than the height and the width is 2 less than the height. Find the longest side of the box. Answer: ______
questions.explanation: Let the height be \(h\). Volume \(=h^{3} + 5 h^{2} - 14 h=312\) gives \(h^{3} + 5 h^{2} - 14 h - 312=0\). Trying divisors of the constant term, \(h=6\) works, so the sides are \(6, 13, 4\). The other roots are negative, so they are rejected.

questions.prompt: The polynomial \(2 k + 2 x^{3} + 3 x^{2} - 5 x\) leaves remainder \(-2\) when divided by \(x + 2\). Find \(k\). Answer: ______
questions.explanation: Remainder \(=p(-2)\). Substituting: \(2 k + 6=-2\), which gives \(k=-4\). Always substitute back to check.

questions.prompt: The polynomial \(5 y^{4} - 5 y^{3} + 2 y^{2} + y - 2\) is a ______ polynomial. (constant, linear, quadratic, cubic or bi-quadratic)
questions.explanation: The highest power of \(y\) is \(4\), so the polynomial has degree \(4\): it is bi-quadratic.

questions.prompt: Find the remainder when \(x^{3} + 7 x^{2} + 4 x + 1\) is divided by \(2 x + 1\). Answer: ______ (fraction or decimal)
questions.explanation: Set \(2 x + 1=0\): \(x=- \frac{1}{2}\). Remainder \(=p(- \frac{1}{2})=\frac{5}{8}\). For a divisor \(ax+b\) use \(x=-b/a\).

questions.prompt: Find the remainder when \(3 x^{3} - 6 x^{2} + 6 x - 6\) is divided by \(2 x - 2\). Answer: ______
questions.explanation: Set \(2 x - 2=0\): \(x=1\). Remainder \(=p(1)=-3\). For a divisor \(ax+b\) use \(x=-b/a\).

questions.prompt: \(a x^{2} + x^{3} - 3 x + 4\) and \(2 a + x^{3} + 2 x^{2} + 2 x\) leave the same remainder when divided by \(x + 2\). Find \(a\). Answer: ______
questions.explanation: Remainders: \(f(-2)=4 a + 2\) and \(g(-2)=2 a - 4\). Equate them: \(a=-3\).

questions.prompt: Without long division, find the remainder when \(2 x^{3} + 2 x^{2} + 7 x - 3\) is divided by \(x\). Answer: ______
questions.explanation: Divisor \(x\) gives \(x=0\). The remainder \(p(0)=-3\) is the constant term: no division needed.

questions.prompt: Find the remainder when \(y^{3} - 3 y^{2} - 2 y + 3\) is divided by \(y + 2\). Answer: ______
questions.explanation: The divisor \(y + 2\) is zero when \(y=-2\). By the Remainder Theorem the remainder is \(p(-2)=-13\). (A common slip is to use \(p(2)\) = \(-5\): the sign of c is opposite to the sign in the divisor.)

questions.prompt: A polynomial of degree \(5\) is divided by a polynomial of degree \(1\). What is the degree of the quotient? Answer: ______
questions.explanation: degree of quotient = degree of dividend − degree of divisor = \(5-1=4\).

questions.prompt: Find the remainder when \(2 t^{3} + 5 t^{2} + 3 t - 2\) is divided by \(3 t + 1\). Answer: ______ (fraction or decimal)
questions.explanation: Set \(3 t + 1=0\): \(t=- \frac{1}{3}\). Remainder \(=p(- \frac{1}{3})=- \frac{68}{27}\). For a divisor \(ax+b\) use \(x=-b/a\).

questions.prompt: Find the remainder when \(y^{3} - 3 y^{2} + 3 y - 1\) is divided by \(y + 2\). Answer: ______
questions.explanation: The divisor \(y + 2\) is zero when \(y=-2\). By the Remainder Theorem the remainder is \(p(-2)=-27\). (A common slip is to use \(p(2)\) = \(1\): the sign of c is opposite to the sign in the divisor.)

questions.prompt: Find the remainder when \(3 z^{4} + 2 z^{3} - 7 z^{2} + 3 z - 8\) is divided by \(z + 4\). Answer: ______
questions.explanation: The divisor \(z + 4\) is zero when \(z=-4\). By the Remainder Theorem the remainder is \(p(-4)=508\). (A common slip is to use \(p(4)\) = \(788\): the sign of c is opposite to the sign in the divisor.)

questions.prompt: The volume of a rectangular box is \(768\) cubic units. The width is 3 times the height and the length is 4 more than the width. Find the longest side of the box. Answer: ______
questions.explanation: Let the height be \(h\). Volume \(=9 h^{3} + 12 h^{2}=768\) gives \(9 h^{3} + 12 h^{2} - 768=0\). Trying divisors of the constant term, \(h=4\) works, so the sides are \(4, 12, 16\). The other roots are negative, so they are rejected.
